summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Drawing Request Form (DRF) dialog changes. All critical requirements verified: Project Name field removed, field order correct, required validation working, Repeat Order features functional.

✅ Field order correct: Nama Customer → No. PO Customer → Tanggal Terima PO → Due Date Target Drawing
✅ Required validation for 'Tanggal Terima PO' works - blocks save with toast 'Tanggal Terima PO wajib diisi'
✅ Required validation for 'Due Date Target Drawing' works - blocks save with toast 'Due Date Target Drawing wajib diisi'

✅ Repeat Order manual SO toggle works (drf-ref-manual-toggle)

✅ Repeat Order reference SO selection works - selecting SO 005251 via drf-ref-so-search
